entities.summary: Khalaj is a Turkic language spoken in Iran. Although it contains many old Turkic elements, it has become widely Persianized. Khalaj has about 150 words of uncertain origin. Khalaj is a modern language with roots in Asia. A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
